# Sesoris

> Sesoris is an online store specializing in home organization products, storage solutions, and lifestyle accessories for Indonesian homes.

## About

Sesoris curates home organization products across categories including home decor, kitchen and dining, desk accessories, travel organizers, personal care, and practical household tools.

## Products

- Home & Decor: Floating shelves, organizers, desk accessories
- Kitchen & Dining: Dish racks, food containers, kitchen storage
- Tools & Gadgets: Multi-tools, smart accessories
- Gift Sets: Premium gift boxes, curated sets
- Personal Care: Aromatherapy, wellness products
- Tech Accessories: Wireless earbuds, charging accessories
- Bags & Pouches: Travel pouches, storage pouches, and everyday carry organizers
- Office & Desk: Desk organizers, task lighting, and cable-management accessories
- Outdoor & Travel: Toiletry bags, hanging organizers, and lightweight travel bags

## Blog

Sesoris Blog covers home organization tips, storage solutions, interior design inspiration, and lifestyle guides at /blog

## AI and Search Access

- Public pages may be crawled for search, answer generation, and citation.
- Private account, cart, checkout, login, registration, wishlist, and API routes are excluded in /robots.txt.
- Preferred canonical host: https://www.sesoris.com
- XML sitemaps: /sitemap.xml and /blog/sitemap.xml
